title: BEST APP FOR PEOPLE WHO CANT MANAGE TIME WELL
body:
Also maybe, you just have ADHD 
Jkjk

I have made about 5 habits, I was disappointed that I had to pay if I wanted to make more. But, then I saw the price. It was only Rp49.000 for a yearly subscription? (That’s around $3 only!) And for a lifetime subscription, it was only Rp150.000, aka $14! This app is a must have for people who are procrastinators, like me haha. I’ve only realized in my 20 years or so of age, habits are VERY very important to make so you can have a better life! 

You guys should invest in yourself and this is a great start! Invest in making healthy habits daily while also enjoying the things that make life fun and awesome. If you’re reading this, I hope you’ll have a great day or night, and a great journey of self discovery and improvement ahead. Lots of love ❤️ and a big thank you to the app developers, you guys slayed with this one ⭐️
